issues.problem: The description quotes a passage that no longer appears in the call, dossier or brief (the dossier was revised): "No new-site ethics amendment or access application has been submitted or approved.". A trap must quote the material the system actually receives.
issues.fix: Quote the dossier's current wording for the same fact (or the brief's, if the quote was from the brief). Check that the fact still holds in the revised dossier and that the trap is still decidable; if the dossier now states it differently, adjust the description and expected behaviour to the current text. Change nothing else.
